$comment: Deployment tiers for skill-clusters. ACTIVE clusters are symlinked into ~/.agents/skills by default (the agent's working set). DEFERRED clusters stay in the repo (canonical, still published to skills.sh) but are NOT deployed locally until activated on demand: `npm run tier -- --activate <cluster>` (e.g. when debugging an old project). Manage with scripts/tier.mjs.
$comment_preserve: Enumerated links that are deliberately outside the cluster system and must survive tier.mjs. Without this they appear in `toRemove` and are de-enumerated on the next --apply: _MOTIONSKIN is a hand-made alias to the `motionskin` spoke and carries a SKILL.md, so it is how the harness surfaces that skill; selemene-cheatsheet.md is a document, not a skill directory. Neither is data loss (both targets live in the repo) but both are silent breakage.
